recent.text: Spurs roll the Warriors by 38 points in their first full game without the injured Steph Curry. GSW drop to 8-5. They have two off days before a Monday night game in New Orleans.
recent.author: Anthony Slater

recent.text: Final: Spurs 123, Warriors 85 Monday in New Orleans should be far more competitive. Yaxel Lendeborg and Brandin Podziemski unable to operate the offense as the lead options. GSW looked lost the entire game. Shot 33% from the field. LJ Cryer scored a career-high 20 points.
recent.author: Danny Emerman

recent.text: Warriors down 97-60 after 3Q. In back-to-back wins in San Antonio last year, Steph Curry scored a combined 95 points. It'll take a monster fourth quarter for the Warriors to crack 95 as a team. GSW shooting 30% from the field. Spurs well on their way to their 11th straight win.
recent.author: Danny Emerman

recent.text: Warriors trail the Spurs 63-33 at halftime. Not exactly a soft landing spot to start an extended stretch without Steph Curry. Yaxel Lendeborg having a hard time as the No. 1 option. 1-for-7 with 2 TOV. Brandin Podziemski 3 points on 1-for-8 shooting in a likewise elevated role.
